title: How to Provide Support the Right Way
coreMove: Conditional support keeps love steady while tying money and housing to recovery, so your help builds someone up instead of paying for the problem.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Chris's brother refusing the business loan
exampleSpecs.audience: Willow and readers facing conditional support
exampleSpecs.stakes: A loving no can express more belief than a rescue loan.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Willow using conditional support in the source case without controlling another person.
